newsitem.title: USA: Enough aluminum smelters for time being - Alumax.
newsitem.headline: Enough aluminum smelters for time being - Alumax.

text.p: No new primary aluminum smelting or extruding capacity was needed in the world at the present time, Allen Born, Chief Executive of Alumax Inc said.
"It will be at least two years before anybody needs to expand capacity," Born told reporters at Alumitech, an industry forum organised by the Aluminum Association.
Nevertheless, Alumax was still keeping alive its project to build an aluminum smelter in Iceland, and looking at the possibility of expanding the low cost Lauralco smelter in Canada.
But at the present time, Alumax was looking at acquiring plants rather than building new ones.
As for Alumax taking part in the privatization of Venezuela's aluminum industry, Born said: "It's existing production and does not rock the boat."
Alumax has made no final decision about whether to bid.
"We have bowed out for the time being," Born said.
